heading: ## Repeated controls and gate registry — round 12

findings.quote: S004 and S265 (S026 superseded by S265, `corpus/SOURCES.md:503`)
findings.why: The cited line does not carry that statement at 9cf0146b. `corpus/SOURCES.md:503` at C0 is `- Next unused id: S265 (staged ids S161–S255 stay reserved by document for the package).` — the stale id line the file itself says was never updated; the supersession sentence `Round 48: four rows added, S265-S268 (superseding held S026, S048, S093, S108; ...)` is at `:504`. The anchor was correct when written (`:500` at 5b703c6, `:503` after the round-54 C1 fix at 99c3bc8, matching the supersession line at each rev) and C0 itself broke it: 9cf0146 inserts the S280 row at SOURCES hunk `@@ -154,0 +155 @@`, shifting every later line by one, so `:503` now resolves to the wrong line. The claim (S026 superseded by S265; S004 and S265 are the section's sources) is otherwise true at C0 — S004 is row 15 and S265 is row 140, both with `corpus/knowledge/repeated-control-precondition.md` as used-by. Repair: `:503` → `:504`, or cite the round-48 line by content.
